caps: There are *SEVEN* worlds | below your feet.
lines.tts: There are seven worlds, below your feet.

caps: And not one of them | is *HELL.*
lines.tts: And not one of them, is hell.

caps: and said they were more beautiful | than *INDRA'S* heaven.
lines.tts: Naarad Muni went down there, and said they were more beautiful than Indra's heaven.
Seven worlds, each ten thousand yojan deep.

caps: *BALA,* the son of Maya, | made *96* kinds of *MAGIC* here.
lines.tts: First, Atal. Bal, the son of Maya, made ninety six kinds of magic here.

caps: *SHIVA* lives here | as the lord of *GOLD.*
lines.tts: Vithal. Shiva lives here, as the lord of gold.

caps: And at his door, | *VISHNU* himself stands guard,
lines.tts: Sutal, the world of King Bali. And at his door, Vishnu himself stands guard, mace in hand.

caps: then, pleased with him, | gave his kingdom back.
lines.tts: Talaatal. Maya, the demon architect. Shiva once burned his three cities, then, pleased with him, gave his kingdom back.
Mahaatal. Serpents with many hoods, always afraid of Garud.

caps: hiding in holes, | in fear of *INDRA.*
lines.tts: Rasaatal. Demons, enemies of the gods, hiding in holes, in fear of Indra.

caps: And the deepest, *PATAL,* | where *VASUKI* rules the *NAGAS.*
No sun shines here. | The *JEWELS* on their hoods
lines.tts: And the deepest, Paataal, where Vaasuki rules the Naags. No sun shines here. The jewels on their hoods light everything.

caps: on *ONE* hood, | like a mustard seed.
lines.tts: But below all seven, Anant Shesh holds the whole universe, on one hood, like a mustard seed.

caps: *SAVE* this, | and send it to someone
lines.tts: Save this, and send it to someone who thinks, Paataal is hell.
Which world would you visit? Comment!
